name: Pendry Newport Beach
positioning: Contemporary resort in coastal Orange County, with a pool, Spa Pendry and the beaches of Corona Del Mar and Crystal Cove moments away
best_for: Travelers who want a resort base close to Newport Beach's beaches and Fashion Island
Families, thanks to the Paintbox kids' program
Weddings and events with large indoor and outdoor spaces

facts.text: Pendry Newport Beach is a resort in coastal Orange County, California.
The beaches of Corona Del Mar and Crystal Cove are moments away from the hotel.
The hotel's neighborhood guide covers Orange County spots from Fashion Island to theme parks.
All rooms have Exclusively Pendry bath products, Pendry signature bedding and curated mini bars.
The resort has an outdoor pool with an expansive lounging deck.
The fitness center is open 24/7 and has Peloton and TechnoGym equipment.
The hotel has more than 58,000 square feet of event space, including a grand ballroom, an al fresco Event Lawn and intimate Salons.
The Elwood Club is the hotel's private members' club.
SET Steak & Sushi pairs a classic steakhouse with a fresh sushi menu and local sustainable seafood.
Pendry partners with brands including Cadillac, Heidi Merrick and UPPAbaby to offer guests exclusive services and amenities.
Accessible rooms have roll-in showers and handrails.

highlights.text: Many guestrooms and suites have ocean, bay and/or harbor views.
The suites have spacious interiors by Studio Munge.
Guests can take a private charter cruise along the coast to the secluded shores of Emerald Bay.
Spa Pendry is a coastal-inspired spa that welcomes resort guests and locals.
Paintbox is a children's program with custom activities, events and arts and crafts tailored to age and interests.

considerations.text: The hotel is not on the sand: the beaches of Corona Del Mar and Crystal Cove are a short trip away.
The Elwood Club and its Living Room are reserved for club members.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury market positioning.
